base_branch_rationale: Batch 3 consumes the Batch 1 contracts, which are not on main yet, so the wave branches from the Batch 1 branch rather than from main.

owner_start_signal.detail: The owner set the goal to implement the whole cluster plan in batch order; this record bounds Batch 3 wave A.

implementation_scope.summary: One transport-neutral operation registry built from an operations.yaml declaration per package, a descriptor v2 policy enforced at registration, a stateless proposal and approval path, local transport resolution with a fail-closed network path that names every missing gate, and a coverage command that also validates the structure of every package declaration file.

forbidden_files_note: OperationDescriptor and SyncOperationRuntime are forbidden on purpose: the freeze enforces the v2 policy at registration precisely so that neither has to change.
forbidden_behavior: changing OperationDescriptor, SyncOperationRuntime or any existing decision or reason code
adding a table, a column or a migration
registering operations owned by a package other than larena/core
implementing a network transport or any network call
falling back to the local transport when a network resolution fails
adding a public HTTP, REST or MCP surface
changing larena/rest, larena/mcp or any package other than larena/core
touching larena.test or any live environment
push, release or deployment without a separate owner request
test_plan: Plain-PHP package tests in the existing style, no database except where an existing helper already provides one: declaration loading and rejection, registry registration and rejection reasons, descriptor policy, confirmation policy by risk class, proposal and approval including digest mismatch, transport resolution and the gate matrix, coverage report content and exit code, and descriptor file structural validation.
required_tests: a declaration whose operations land under the wrong key is rejected, and the reason names the key: the Batch 2 defect regression
an unknown top-level or operation key, a duplicate name and a wrong package are each rejected
registration rejects an undeclared risk class, a mutation without an audit event, a transactional operation without an idempotency key and any missing schema reference, each with its own reason code
registration rejects a descriptor that disagrees with its declaration and names the first disagreeing field
describe and descriptorFor of an unknown name fail closed; has returns false
the confirmation policy returns not required for a read and a reversible change and required for bulk, irreversible, external and a non-reversible change
a proposal writes nothing and returns a receipt carrying the proposal digest
the same operation with a matching approval writes; a mismatched digest, a wrong operation and a missing approval where confirmation is required each fail closed
a mutation whose handler does not support proposal mode fails closed with proposal_unsupported
the transport resolves local with no binding and with a binding on this node
a network resolution lists every missing gate in the frozen order and reports the first as its reason code
the local transport executes with no entitlement gate bound at all
a failed network resolution never executes locally
the coverage report lists declared access operation codes with their registration state and exits non-zero on a policy violation and zero on a scheduled gap
smoke_plan: core:operations:coverage against the root on sqlite and mysql, restart readback of the registry composition, and the transport gate matrix captured as a table.

action_gate_summary.note: Re-run the action gate inside the core package repository at coding start.

stop_conditions: a frozen declaration key set, grammar, reason code or gate order would have to change
an existing operation decision or reason code would change
a table or migration would be required
a network transport implementation would be required to pass a test
OperationDescriptor or SyncOperationRuntime would have to change
a file outside the allowed boundary would have to change
an unrecorded product or architecture decision is required
the core package repository is dirty or not initialized
nonclaims: A launch record authorizes a bounded coding wave; it does not authorize push, release or deployment.
Wave A registers core operations only; coverage of other packages is a recorded gap with a scheduled batch.
Nothing in this wave can make a network call.
